description.value: A free BC Marine Trails campsite near Squamish, accessible only by water; no confirmed facilities or amenities, making it effectively off-limits for loaded touring cyclists arriving by road.

address.value: Anvil Island, Sunshine Coast Regional District, BC, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record describes an informal, free backcountry tent campsite along Howe Sound near Squamish, tagged under the BC Marine Trails network. The linked website page returned a 404 ('Page not found') — BC Marine Trails has migrated their individual site pages to a members-only interactive map — so OSM tags are the sole evidence source. OSM explicitly confirms tents=yes, toilets=no, cabins=no, caravans=no, fee=no, informal=yes, and access=yes.
concerns: The OSM website URL (https://www.bcmarinetrails.org/map_site/anvils-foot/) returns a 404 Page Not Found — BC Marine Trails has migrated individual site pages to a members-only interactive map; the canonical URL is effectively broken.
This site is listed under the BC Marine Trails paddling network and appears to be primarily water-accessed, which may limit its practical relevance to cyclists not combining water and land travel.
informal=yes indicates an unmaintained, unofficial site with no managed facilities or oversight.
No address or phone contact available in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible informal campsite confirmed by OSM tags (access=yes, tents=yes); no evidence of closure. Free primitive camping in a scenic Howe Sound location is useful information for self-supported touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM cabins=no and capacity:caravans=0 further confirm this is a tents-only primitive site. OSM lit=no is consistent with the absence of any electrical infrastructure.

wow_evidence: accessible only by water; effectively off-limits for loaded touring cyclists arriving by road
